summary: Centerra Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing results of its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders held May 5, 2026. The filing reports that 76.39% of shares were represented, all director nominees were elected, KPMG LLP was reappointed as auditor, and an advisory vote on executive compensation was approved. This is a routine regulatory filing of annual meeting outcomes and does not constitute a special situation event.
